item.title: WhatsApp Usernames Are a Bigger Security Win Than They Look

item.description: Why deception belongs in every defender's toolkit, and how Thinkst Canary and canary tokens turn attacker curiosity into high signal alerts.

item.title: Securing SD-WAN: Architecture Considerations
item.description: Key security considerations when designing and deploying Software-Defined Wide Area Networks for enterprise environments.

item.title: My Penetration Testing Methodology: A Practitioner's Guide
item.description: A practical, adversarial approach to penetration testing - from recursive reconnaissance that asks why, to stealth and loud scanning, and a remediation framework that separates quick fixes from proper fixes.

item.title: Lessons from Implementing ISO 27001 in African Enterprises
